headline: Van Barneveld vows to fight on for World Championship place
standfirst: The five-time world champion said he would not retire, with his Ally Pally spot depending on the final Players Championship events in Leicester.
body: Raymond van Barneveld said he has no plans to retire, even though his place at the World Championship depends on the last two Players Championship events of the year in Leicester.
The 59-year-old sat just above the cut-off on the ProTour Order of Merit, which decides direct qualification for Alexandra Palace. Another drop would leave him outside the places.
Van Barneveld told Dutch broadcaster NOS that he had never been in this position before, having usually qualified with ease. He said he would be proud of himself if he made it.

He made his World Championship debut in the BDO in 1991 and won that title four times before taking the PDC crown in 2007. He also said he was working on his mental approach, using meditation and music, and thanked his family and friends for their support.
Dartsnews later reported that he secured his place at the World Championship.
